canonical.title: The Whispering Waves
canonical.description:
A retired lighthouse keeper uncovers the secrets of the past through an old radio that picks up mysterious messages from vanished ships.

Join Jack Harris in this mysterious story about connection to the past. Perfect for general audiences.
